harness.loop/authored/loop-approval-appr.purpose: An approved write reaches the tool port within the same turn; its result opens the next turn.

harness.loop/authored/loop-approval-defe.purpose: A deferred approval suspends the run at a harness.approval-checkpoint/1 checkpoint; the ledger holds the one turn spent.

harness.loop/authored/loop-approval-deni.purpose: A write over the unattended ceiling waits for the approver; a denial is a failed result and the loop turns again.

harness.loop/authored/loop-approval-resu.purpose: A denial resumed from a checkpoint whose conversation passed the compaction trigger opens a summary turn before the next conversation turn.
An approval resumed from the serialized checkpoint runs the exact suspended call and continues the turn count; a resumed run writes no ledger.

harness.loop/authored/loop-cancelled.purpose: A model read the caller cancelled ends the run as a cancelled stop, not a failure.

harness.loop/authored/loop-compaction-su.purpose: A summary turn that fails is counted but bills nothing, and the run goes on with its conversation unfolded.
Long assistant text past the compaction trigger is folded by a summary turn, which is counted and billed like any other turn.

harness.loop/authored/loop-completed-aft.purpose: An unattended read runs at once; the run that ends on the next turn bills both turns in its ledger.

harness.loop/authored/loop-failed-not-re.purpose: A wire failure that is not retriable ends the run failed at once, and the ledger still records the turn it started.

value.message: model wire refused: Protocol: the provider refused the request

harness.loop/authored/loop-retried-then-.purpose: A retried turn that is answered bills once, and its attempts end with the request they belonged to.

harness.loop/authored/loop-retries-exhau.purpose: A retriable wire failure is attempted three more times within the same turn; the fourth failure ends the run failed, with nothing billed.
